text:
When a piece of aluminium foil is added to dilute hydrochloric acid, no effervescence is seen.
Which statement explains why no effervescence is seen?
A
Aluminium does not make a gas when it reacts with an acid.
B
Aluminium has a surface layer of aluminium oxide.
C
Aluminium is less reactive than hydrogen.
D
Aluminium only reacts with concentrated acid.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium does not make a gas when it reacts with an acid.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium has a surface layer of aluminium oxide.

options.label: C
options.text: Aluminium is less reactive than hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: Aluminium only reacts with concentrated acid.
